44542176.description: AC-263093 is a drug used in scientific research which acts as an agonist at the neuropeptide FF receptor NPFF2 and an antagonist for the closely related NPFF1 receptor.

44584288.name: Phillyrin
44584288.description: Phillyrin is a chemical compound isolated from fungi.

44719584.name: Methylenedioxymethoxyethylamphetamine
44719584.description: MDMEOET, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methoxyethylamphetamine or as N-methoxyethyl-MDA, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families.

46782432.name: 6β-Naltrexol-d4
46782432.description: 6β-Naltrexol-d4, also known as 6β-hydroxynaltrexone-d4, is a deuterium-labeled form of 6β-naltrexol used for NMR imaging.

49850464.name: SH-I-048A
49850464.description: SH-I-048A is a benzodiazepine derivative related in structure to compounds such as flubromazepam and meclonazepam.

52921568.name: Penicilloic acid
52921568.description: Penicilloic acid is any of several acids which are obtained from the penicillins by the hydrolytic opening of the lactam ring .

57495136.name: Methyldienolone
57495136.description: Methyldienolone , also known as 17α-methyl-19-nor-δ9-testosterone, as well as 17α-methylestra-4,9-dien-17β-ol-3-one, is a synthetic, orally active anabolic-androgenic steroid and a 17α-alkylated...

60208608.name: Pentylone
60208608.description: Pentylone, also known as β-ketoN-methyl-1,3-benzodioxolylpentanamine , is a stimulant developed in the 1960s.

66570720.name: MAM-2201
66570720.description: MAM-2201 is a drug that presumably acts as a potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors.

68894304.name: ADB-CHMINACA
68894304.description: ADB-CHMINACA (also known as ADMB-CHMINACA and MAB-CHMINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid.

71301472.name: AB-PINACA
71301472.description: AB-PINACA is a compound that was first identified as a component of synthetic cannabis products in Japan in 2012.

71308256.name: Petasis reagent
71308256.description: The Petasis reagent, named after Nicos A. Petasis, is an organotitanium compound with the formula Cp2Ti 2. It is an orange-colored solid.

71316576.name: 4-Ethylmethcathinone
71316576.description: 4-Ethylmethcathinone is a recreational designer drug of the stimulant and entactogen class.

86280672.name: Povorcitinib
86280672.description: Povorcitinib is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of the skin conditions hidradenitis suppurativa and chronic prurigo. It is a JAK1 inhibitor.

86301664.name: Cipepofol
86301664.description: Cipepofol (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name, USANTooltip United States Adopted Name), also known as ciprofol or by its developmental code name HSK3486, sold under the brand name Cypsedo...

89995232.name: Rezvilutamide
89995232.description: Rezvilutamide (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), sold under the brand name Ariane, is a nonsteroidal antiandrogen which is approved for the treatment of prostate cancer in China and is...

91898464.name: Cobratoxin
91898464.description: α-Cobratoxin is a substance of the venom of certain Naja cobras. It is a nicotinic acetylcholine receptor antagonist which causes paralysis by preventing the binding of acetylcholine to the nAChR.

91936864.name: FUB-PB-22
91936864.description: FUB-PB-22 is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

119025888.name: FDU-PB-22
119025888.description: FDU-PB-22 is a derivative of JWH-018 that is presumed to be a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor, and has been sold online as a designer drug.

121008224.name: 4-HO-NET
121008224.description: 4-HO-NET, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-ethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to norpsilocin .

121491808.name: MDMB-CHMINACA
121491808.description: MDMB-CHMINACA (also known as MDMB -CHM) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that acts as a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor, and has been sold online as a designer drug.

122443488.name: Selvigaltin
122443488.description: Selvigaltin is the first small-molecule, orally delivered galectin-3 inhibitor to be discovered.

122662112.name: Fexuprazan
122662112.description: Fexuprazan is a drug for the treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease .

132157920.name: S416
132157920.description: S416 is a drug which acts as a selective inhibitor of the enzyme dihydroorotate dehydrogenase .

134262752.name: Ervogastat
134262752.description: Ervogastat is an experimental small-molecule drug and selective diacylglycerol O-acyltransferase 2 inhibitor developed by Pfizer for non-alcoholic steatohepatitis.

134611040.name: Danuglipron
134611040.description: Danuglipron is a small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist, formerly under development by Pfizer that, in an oral formulation, was under investigation as a therapy for diabetes mellitus.

139583456.name: Granadaene
139583456.description: Granadaene is the trivial name of a polyene of non-isoprenoid biosynthetic origin, that constitutes the red pigment characteristic of Streptococcus agalactiae .

152743520.name: 25CN-NBOMe
152743520.description: 25CN-NBOMe, also known as 2C-CN-NBOMe or NBOMe-2C-CN, is a derivative of the phenethylamine 2C-CN.

165360096.name: 11C ME@HAPTHI
165360096.description: [11C]ME@HAPTHI is a chemical compound used as a radiotracer to image the norepinephrine transporter protein using positron emission tomography .

165360224.name: Potassium ferrooxalate
165360224.description: Potassium ferrooxalate, also known as potassium bisoxalatoferrate , is a salt with the formula K2[Fe 2]·xH2O.

171041248.name: Plutonocene
171041248.description: Plutonocene, Pu 2, is an organoplutonium compound composed of a plutonium atom sandwiched between two cyclooctatetraenide rings.

175794272.name: 11-Chloroasimilobine
175794272.description: 11-Chloroasimilobine, also known as 1-methoxy-2-hydroxy-11-chloronoraporphine, is a serotonin 5-HT2C receptor agonist of the noraporphine family.

175819744.name: 25N-NBPh
175819744.description: 25N-NBPh is a phenethylamine derivative from the 25-NB class, which acts as a potent agonist at the 5-HT2A receptor with weaker activity at 5-HT2B and 5-HT2C.

900000352.name: CPI-CG-8
900000352.description: CPI-CG-8, also known as N-methyl-N- tryptamine, is a "relatively" selective serotonin 5-HT2C receptor agonist of the tryptamine family.

900000608.name: Dicarbollide
900000608.description: In organometallic chemistry, a dicarbollide is an anion of the formula [C2B9H11]2-.

900000736.name: Erbium oxychloride
900000736.description: Erbium oxychloride or erbium oxide chloride is an inorganic compound of erbium, oxygen, and chlorine with the chemical formula ErOCl.

900000864.name: GATC-1021
900000864.description: GATC-1021, also known as 8-fluoroibogainalog, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the ibogalog family related to ibogainalog.

900001120.name: Lauryl methyl gluceth-10 hydroxypropyl dimonium chloride
900001120.wikipedia: Lauryl methyl gluceth-10 hydroxypropyl dimonium chloride
900001120.description: Lauryl methyl gluceth-10 hydroxypropyl dimonium chloride is an ingredient in some types of soaps and personal care products.

900001376.name: Nitronium hexafluorouranate
900001376.description: Nitronium hexafluorouranate is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula NO2UF6, composed of the nitronium cation [NO2]+ and hexafluorouranate anion [UF6]-.

900001504.name: Pegozafermin
900001504.description: Pegozafermin is a long-acting, glycopegylated FGF21 analog developed for the treatment of nonalcoholic steatohepatitis and hypertriglyceridemia.

900001632.name: Polydiethylstilbestrol phosphate
900001632.description: Polydiethylstilbestrol phosphate is an estrogen medication which has been used in scientific research and has been studied for use in veterinary medicine as a livestock growth promoter.

900001760.name: Radretumab
900001760.description: Radretumab is an antineoplastic. Philogen, a pharmaceutical company specializing in antibody-drug conjugates, is developing it as a conjugate of Iodine-131 to an antibody which binds to fibronectin...

900002016.name: Tetracyanoborate
900002016.description: Tetracyanoborate ( tetracyanidoborate, or tetracyanoboranuide) is an anion or salt of this anion.

900002144.name: Vedolizumab
900002144.description: Vedolizumab, sold under the brand name Entyvio, is a monoclonal antibody medication developed by Takeda Oncology for the treatment of ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease.
